intent: An answer card that streams a cited answer in natural, uneven chunks, then reveals its sources, with Stop / Regenerate / Copy controls.

stack.fonts: font-sans (Geist, semibold) for the question, font-sans (Geist) for the answer, font-mono (Geist Mono) for status and labels

layout.card: max-w 820px, #0b0b0c, radius 24px, 1px ring white/8%, inset top highlight, deep black shadow; three bands split by 1px white/8% rules: header, answer, footer
layout.header: mono 'Asked by' line with a 20px accent hairline, then the semibold question
layout.answer: 24px status row, body with min-height 12rem, then sources
layout.sources: ol between hairlines; rows are grid [2rem number | title + publisher | arrow], min 48px tall
layout.footer: mono disclaimer left; Stop/Regenerate and Copy right; wraps on phones

color.accent: #ff9a6b (caret, citation pills, status dot, source numbers, focus); active pills are solid with black text

motion.reading: 900ms: pinging dot, 'Reading N sources', pulsing dots, three breathing skeleton lines
motion.tokenising: word tokens with whitespace; citations and bold runs atomic
motion.pacing: 1–3 tokens per tick; 14–48ms between words, 50–120ms after , ; —, 110–270ms after sentences, 260–480ms between paragraphs, 4% chance of a 180–380ms hesitation; `pace` multiplies all delays
motion.sources: fade up 8px over 550ms, rows slide 6px from the left staggered 60ms, ease [0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1]
motion.linking: hovering or focusing a citation highlights its source and vice versa
motion.reducedMotion: full answer and sources render immediately; no caret, skeleton or ping

responsive.mobile: 16px gutters, card padding 24px, answer 16.5px, footer wraps, 44px buttons

accessibility: answer region aria-live=polite with aria-busy while reading/streaming
citations are links to the source anchors with aria-label 'Source n: title'
sources are an ordered list under an h3
text-labelled buttons with 2px accent focus rings; Copy disabled while streaming
reduced motion renders the finished answer

content.question: Why does my sourdough collapse when it goes in the oven?
content.answer: four paragraphs on overproofing, the poke test, hydration and preheating, with five citations
